purpose: Review criteria for code review: lists the delegated SSOT documents to check by priority, the check order, and the rules for choosing fix, create_issue or skip.
summary: Delegates severity and gray-zone judgment to principles documents; holds no judgment itself
P1 SSOT table: project-specific rules, related design docs, deterministic generation spec
P2 consistency check between design docs and target files
P3 unnecessary complexity check via anti-patterns document
Check order: P1 rule match, P2 contradiction, P3 complexity
Recommendation rules: fix, create_issue, skip with adoption conditions
Three conditions for create_issue: no applicable rule, recurrence or objectivity, codifiable granularity
Fallback to built-in rules when project rules are missing
tasks: Reviewing source code against project rules
Building a review packet for code review
Judging fix, create_issue or skip for code findings
Checking code against related design documents
title: code レビュー基準
